name: Waldorf Pulse
description: Waldorf Pulse and Pulse Plus analog synthesizer (OS 2.0): every sound parameter as its control change, read back from the program dump.

sources.title: User’s Manual Pulse • PulsePlus, version 2.0

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/waldorf/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/waldorf/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's controller chart, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The Pulse has no request for its edit buffer: Pull asks for a stored program, the program variable (0 for P.1 … 98 for P.99, 99 for P.rn), so what comes back is that program as stored. A program dump sent from the panel (Shift + Dump, Program Dump) is the current program, edits and all, and is read back as it arrives.
The panel's Controller Dump, and its request ($4B), send the current program as these control changes, which CEditor follows as they come.

Read through this profile, Waldorf's published Pulse sound sets hold a few values the manual does not list: Portamento Mode 2 or 3 in 12 of 125 programs (it names normal and fingered), Arpeggiator Range above 9 in 5, Arpeggiator Mode 15 in 4. A Pull of such a program shows the number.

Program dump bytes the manual's table names otherwise, corrected by the layout: byte 65 is Cutoff Mod Amount (printed Cutoff Mod Source), byte 66 is Cutoff Mod Source (printed Cutoff Mod Amount). In all 125 programs of the sound sets Waldorf publishes for the Pulse, byte 66 holds 0 - 15 and byte 65 values spread around 64, as an amount does; and the dump puts an amount before its source everywhere else (Pitch Mod Amount 39, Pitch Mod Source 40).
Pull: Program dump request (the program variable). 68 of 68 parameters are read back. Nothing is read on connect: the program asked for is not necessarily the one playing.

Left out, performance and channel mode controllers, which change no setting of the sound: CC 1 Mod Wheel, CC 2 Breath Control, CC 7 Main Volume, CC 64 Sustain Switch, CC 121 Reset All Controls, CC 123 All Notes Off.
